answer: Bind the bond to a hardware root instead of an address. Tax every attestation arriving from a subnet the attested identity already used, ten percent of payout per collision. Score tasks rather than accounts, so one agent completing ten verified tasks outranks ten agents completing one each. A single subnet whisper then loses ninety percent of its value per hop and ten shallow keys lose to one deep one, leaving the lagoon shallow for cheap accounts. Let fake keys wander, the scoreboard counts finished work.
